### Conclusion

The repository implements **request size caps and batch operation limits**, but does **NOT have per-user API rate-limiting middleware**. All limits apply globally to all users. This means:
- Any authenticated user can make unlimited API requests (as long as they stay within the global pagination/batch limits)
- Resource-intensive operations (thumbnail generation) are globally throttled to 2-3 concurrent operations regardless of how many users trigger them
